summary: Iteration 4 full regression for navy #22316a corporate redesign with 3 separate registration CRMs (visitors / exhibitors / speaker-applications). Backend 30/30 pytest cases pass (all new endpoints + duplicate guards + filters + PATCH/DELETE + dashboard stats + email broadcast recipient types). Frontend: Poppins font, navy/yellow theme confirmed (0 elements with old orange #F39200), left drawer shows all 4 registration links (Ziyaretçi/Stant/Konuşmacı/Bülten), all 3 public registration pages submit successfully, conditional fields work (sponsor→paket, konuşmaci→topic), all redirects OK (/zirve-kaydi and /uyelik → /ziyaretci-kaydi; /admin/uyeler → /admin/bulten-uyeleri; /admin/misafirler → /admin/ziyaretciler), admin login works, admin CRM pages render with status tabs, search, table, CSV İndir, Toplu Email.

minor.issue: Returns 200 with sendgrid_configured:false when SENDGRID not configured (by design, but might be 503 more accurately). Cosmetic - same as iter 3.

issues: Section heading reads 'KAYIT TÜRLERİ' (review request mentioned '3 KAYIT TÜRÜ'). The 3 cards (Ziyaretçi with EN POPÜLER badge, Stant, Konuşmacı/Sponsor) are all present and correct - label difference is cosmetic only.
Navy #22316a and yellow accent confirmed site-wide. Poppins font family in use. 0 elements retain old orange (#F39200) per DOM scan.

Ziyaretçiler, Fuar Stant, Konuşmacı/Sponsor pages all render with: status filter tabs (Tümü/Yeni/İletişim Kuruldu/Onaylandı/Reddedildi), search input, results table, CSV İndir button, Toplu Email button. Sidebar navigation shows all 11 admin sections.

action_items: No blocking issues. Optional: change homepage section title from 'KAYIT TÜRLERİ' to '3 KAYIT TÜRÜ' if exact match with spec desired (cosmetic).
Optional: return HTTP 503 instead of 200 on /api/admin/email/send when SendGrid not configured (cosmetic).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1100+ lines - splitting into routers/ modules (auth, public, registration, admin_*) strongly recommended.
JWT_SECRET still has hard-coded default fallback - switch to fail-fast on missing env for production.
No rate limiting on /api/auth/login - add slowapi before public launch.
Duplicate email error messages returned in Turkish with HTTPException(400, '...') - fine for UI, but consider standardised error envelope {code, message} for API consumers.
register_exhibitor / register_speaker_application share almost identical shape (create → insert → send_email → return id). Small helper could DRY this (~20 duplicated lines each).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (3 public forms submit OK, 3 redirects OK, 4 admin CRM pages render OK, theme + drawer verified)
